Recovery · Poland

Suspected Russian military drone recovered off Rusinowo beach, Poland

14 September 2026 · Rusinowo · Jarosławiec coast

Military-drone recovery; preliminary foreign attribution

On 14 September 2026 the Polish military located a suspected military drone in the Baltic Sea just off Rusinowo beach, close to Jarosławiec on the coast of Poland, and pulled it from the water for examination. The date is that of the discovery and recovery; when the drone flew, and by what route it reached the Polish coast, is not known.

Poland’s defence minister said the preliminary assessment was that it was a Russian military drone. That identification is preliminary and depends on the examination of the recovered drone. No payload was reported.

No casualties or damage were reported in connection with the find.
